question: What alternative arrangement applies to the base and related elements?
premises: The base and so forth may be arranged as two-cornered and round.
This is presented as an alternative.
It refers to that same form.
inference: Alternatively, the base and related elements of that same form may be arranged as two-cornered and round.
plain_english: Or indeed, that same base and so forth may be arranged as two-cornered and round.
